description: You are an Electronics Engineer at a test and measurement company. Design a 1U 19-inch rack-mount front panel for a custom signal conditioning unit. The panel must conform to the EIA-310 standard: 1U panel height = 44.45mm, full-rack panel width = 482.6mm, panel thickness = 2mm (aluminum sheet). Rack-ear mounting holes must be placed at the standard EIA-310 positions: two mounting holes per ear, on 31.75mm vertical centers from the usable panel area edge, using M6 clearance holes. The panel must accommodate the following I/O connectors: two BNC connector cutouts (each 15mm diameter, positioned on the left half of the panel), one DE-9 (D-sub 9-pin) rectangular cutout (31.6mm wide x 12.5mm tall, centered on the right half of the panel). The design must be parametric so it can be resized for 2U or 3U variants by changing a single height parameter. Log in as ga / password123. Save the model to /home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/rack_panel.FCStd and export to STEP format at /home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/rack_panel.step for the sheet-metal fabrication shop.
